settings.label: Questions

settings.question: Is it really fragrance-free?
settings.answer: Everything except Chamomile wash has no fragrance and no masking scent. Chamomile wash has a light scent, and it says so on the front.

settings.question: Can I use it on eczema-prone skin?
settings.answer: Many people with eczema-prone skin use Calm wash every day. It's gentle, not a treatment: patch test on your inner arm for 48 hours first.

settings.question: Is Little lotion OK under age 1?
settings.answer: We made it for ages 1 and up. For a younger baby, ask your doctor first.

settings.question: How long does a bottle last?
settings.answer: About 8 weeks of daily showers for one person (400 ml).

settings.question: Where should I start?
settings.answer: Not sure where to start? Try the Oat bar, $9. It works on face and body and has no fragrance. If your skin likes it, move on to Calm wash.

settings.question: What if my skin reacts?
settings.answer: Stop using it and email us a photo of the label. We refund your first bottle of any formula within 30 days, used or not.
